articles.headline: IQE swings to first-half core profit as AI and data-centre demand supports growth
articles.summary: IQE said rising demand tied to AI and data centres helped it return to first-half core profit and keep its annual outlook. For businesses, this points to continued strength in infrastructure spending that can affect supply chains, component pricing, and availability in the semiconductor ecosystem.

articles.headline: Large firms increasingly scrutinize dependence on critical digital infrastructure amid geopolitics and cyber risk
articles.summary: A Capgemini survey highlighted that large companies and public bodies are reassessing their reliance on critical digital infrastructure as geopolitical tensions, export controls, and cyber threats expose vulnerabilities. That makes this directly relevant to vendor risk, continuity planning, and resilience spending for enterprise buyers.

articles.headline: Nvidia bets $13 billion on open AI models with Hugging Face deal
articles.summary: Nvidia’s large investment underscores how quickly AI infrastructure is consolidating around ecosystem partnerships and model distribution. For businesses, this can influence the economics of AI deployment, vendor selection, and the cost/availability of tooling built on Nvidia’s stack.
